title: Intern Investment Strategy Analyst
full_description:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiasticinternto join ourInvestment Strategyunit.
This team is responsible forproducing and disseminating economic and financial markets intelligence both inside and outside the bank.
You will help us maintain and improve the foundations for a macro/investment office function.
You will also help the team create and deliver content that helps customers change their perception of the bank.
Your key responsibilities:
• Assistance in the preparation of reports related to macroeconomic and financial markets developments.
• Maintenance and exploitation of database (Macrobond).
• Preparation of reports and presentations on functional monitors (macroeconomics, banking, and financial markets).
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
Students or recent graduateswith a master’s or bachelor’s degree inbusinessoreconomics,no previous experience required.
Passionate aboutfinancial marketsandmacroeconomics.
A bornfinancial newsfollower.
Data-driven, withcommon senseand attention todetail.
Stronganalyticalskills.
Greatorganizational,oral, andwrittencommunicationskills.
Strong ability to makeeffective presentations: effective storytelling, excellentPowerPointskills.
Good knowledge ofExcel.
Previous experience of usingBloombergwould be an advantage.
Able to work in anautonomousway, to takeinitiativeand to make things happen with acan-doattitude.
Goodteam player, willing to collaborate with different people.
Very good oral and writtenEnglishskills, with at least levelC1.
Ability to work at aninternationallevel.
Minimumavailability of6 months, renewable according to the university's criteria.

Buscamos un becario con talento y entusiasmo para incorporarse a nuestra Unidad deInvestment Strategy.
Este equipo es responsable de producir y difundir inteligencia económica y mercados financieros tanto dentro como fuera del banco.
Nos ayudarás a mantener y mejorar las bases de una función de oficina macro/inversión.
También ayudarás al equipo a crear y difundir contenidos que ayuden a los clientes a cambiar su percepción del banco.
Tus principales tareas:
- Apoyo en la elaboración de informes relacionados con la evolución macroeconómica.
- Mantenimiento y explotación de la base de datos (Macrobond).
- Preparación de informes y presentaciones sobre monitores funcionales y mercados financieros (macroeconomía, banca y mercados financieros).
